title: On a Generalized Compartment Model for Ethanol Metabolism in the Human Body
summary: We introduce a generalized continuous-time compartment model of ethanol metabolism in the human body that extends a recently developed framework. In the proposed model, we replace the Michaelis-Menten mechanism of the liver's ethanol metabolism rate with a general class of nonlinear rate functions. This modification provides greater modeling flexibility and enables the model to capture a wider range of hepatic ethanol metabolism dynamics.
